card.name: The word Image after a sentence
card.fires_on: The word "Image" (or "image") right after a sentence ends, standing in for a picture or figure placeholder. Seen in drug-label sections and in web page captions.

modes.label: Image placeholder in labels
modes.description: "Image" appears alone after a full stop in dosing, preparation or clinical text where a figure was removed.

modes.description: "Image" starts a caption or credit line in general web text.
